evals.prompt: 我想给团队做个新 member onboarding 流程，顺便把文档站也改了。你先别问那么多，直接开干吧。
scripted_replies: 别问了，直接做，按你觉得对的来。
evals.expected_output: States the significant how-it-gets-made choice in one plain line, ends the skill, and proceeds through the normal workflow. No design doc, no gate.
assertions: Offers the one-line opt-out path instead of forcing the conversation.
On opt-out, states the significant production choice plainly and drops the approval gate.
Does not write a design doc or run a builder check for the opted-out task.

evals.prompt: 把登录页的主按钮从蓝色改成品牌绿色，就这么个小改动。
scripted_replies: 用户群就是现有 web 端用户，成功就是颜色一致无回归。
描述没问题，按这个改吧。
evals.expected_output: A short playback plus small-change sizing with the full in-chat description, an explicit approval, and no design doc.
assertions: Plays back the understood part before asking about the next part.
Sizes the work as a small change with the full description in chat.
Does not build before the partner approves the in-chat description.

evals.prompt: 我们要做一个新功能：给订单服务加支付回调对账。现在回调、本地订单状态、财务流水可能不一致，从意图开始聊，最后要一份设计文档。
scripted_replies: 背景是每周对账靠人工，成功是零人工介入且差异可解释；先网关后服务，语言沿用现有 Go。
非目标是实时大屏；反目标是自动调账。
文档可以，builder 意见里只有网关超时取值要我定：取 5s。
evals.expected_output: A committed design doc covering intent, goals/non-goals/anti-goals, constraints, and decided how; a one-round builder check; no product code before doc approval; then plan mode.
assertions: Writes the design doc with intent, why, goals/non-goals/anti-goals, constraints, and decided how.
Runs a single-round builder check and brings back only partner-answerable questions.
Does not write product code, scaffold, install deps, or invoke an implementation skill before doc approval.
After approval, goes to plan mode rather than implementing directly.

evals.prompt: 不确定缓存要不要加，先随便写个能跑的验证下命中率，几小时的事。
scripted_replies: 行，先 spike 看看效果。
evals.expected_output: A throwaway spike offer with minimal tests that feeds learnings back; keeping the output requires a new request through the gate.
assertions: Labels the spike throwaway with no or minimal tests.
Brings spike learnings back into the conversation.
Treats keeping spike output as a new request through the approval gate.

evals.prompt: 这是一个视觉布局问题：侧栏还是顶栏，先出两个稿给我看。顺便想想要不要做个季度业务复盘演讲。
evals.expected_output: Routes the layout comparison to oms-visualization and keeps the talk itself in this skill. Does not absorb layout mockups here or reroute the non-software talk away.
assertions: Does not treat a visual layout comparison as an oms-brainstorming discovery chunk.
Routes look-at-able mockups to oms-visualization instead of starting a preview server here.
Keeps the non-software talk in scope for intent discovery.
